findings.message: `CONN_APP_INVALID_APP_ID` and `CONN_APP_INVALID_INSTALLATION_ID` are added here (and their connections registered in `setup_connections` at lines 186-209) but no test in this PR uses them. Either add the tests that assert what a non-integer `github_app_id`/`github_installation_id` does, or drop the two constants and their connection fixtures.

The two new rejection branches added here - `if self.auth_token: raise ValueError("Password field must be empty to use GitHub App Auth")` and the non-HTTPS `repo_url` guard below it - are only exercised on their passing side by the added tests. Add cases for a GitHub App connection that also sets a password and one whose host is an ssh/non-HTTPS URL, asserting each ValueError.
